extracted.name: Pineapple Rocket Salad
extracted.description: Try this arugula salad with pineapple for a tasty combination of peppery rocket and tart fruit tossed in a sweet vinaigrette.
instruction_lines: Mix arugula, pineapple, cilantro, and onion together in a salad bowl.
